title: Srot: verified Indian government geodata in QGIS
description:
Srot brings verified Indian government geodata into QGIS, each layer carrying its own citation.

The Browse tab lists the catalogue — 342 ISRO Bhuvan layers across 44 states and union territories, the Census and Survey of India boundary sets, live data.gov.in feeds and OpenStreetMap presets — as a searchable list with an Add button, requiring no language model; only the data.gov.in feeds ask for a free portal key. The Ask tab takes a sentence instead, for requests that combine several steps.

Bhuvan serves layers that are valid and empty, so coverage is measured rather than assumed: Srot probes a layer before adding it and reports whether anything drew. Publisher, licence, source URL and retrieval date are written into each layer's metadata as it loads, and the project can export its own bibliography as plain text, Markdown or BibTeX. Every session also exports as a runnable PyQGIS script that reproduces the work without the plugin and without a model.

QGIS 3.28 to 4.99. No third-party Python dependencies.
